repository.name: airflow
repository.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

issue.body:
Closes #72265.

The Kubernetes task source-rewrite and YAML deletion utilities had no direct tests. This adds coverage for generated task source, API dispatch and deletion error reporting, and removes their two corresponding `OVERLOOKED_TESTS` exemptions.

The tests cover task/lifecycle decorator removal, unrelated decorators, Jinja rendering, missing context, API-group/kind conversion, namespaced and cluster-scoped deletion, namespace precedence, List expansion, aggregated errors, YAML forwarding and verbose status output. Kubernetes API constructors use `autospec=True`, and response doubles expose only their expected status interface; no cluster is required.

Rebased onto current Apache `main` at `18fe1c60986`, retaining the September 18 review coverage and upstream's removal of other obsolete test exemptions. The scope remains two test modules and their matching exemptions; production utilities are unchanged.

- `test_python_kubernetes_script.py` — covers `remove_task_decorator` (plain, parametrized, and nested-parentheses decorators; `@setup`/`@teardown` removal; unchanged output when the decorator is absent) and `write_python_script` (template rendering, `NativeEnvironment` selection via `render_template_as_native_obj`, `StrictUndefined` raising on missing context variables).
- `utils/test_delete_from.py` — covers API class derivation from `apiVersion` (core group, named group, `.k8s.io` stripping, DNS-subdomain conversion), CamelCase-to-snake_case kind conversion, namespaced vs cluster-scoped dispatch, document-metadata namespace precedence, `List` kind fan-out, `ApiException` collection into `FailToDeleteError`, and `FailToDeleteError.__str__` formatting. All driven with mocked `kubernetes.client` APIs; no cluster required.

## Description

Related to #72265 (Part of missing unit tests for `providers/cncf/kubernetes`).

This PR adds comprehensive unit test coverage for the remaining uncovered modules in `providers/cncf/kubernetes`:
1. `airflow.providers.cncf.kubernetes.python_kubernetes_script`:
   - `_balance_parens`: verifies parenthesis matching with nested constructs.
   - `remove_task_decorator`: verifies stripping of `@task.kubernetes` with and without arguments, nested arguments, and `@setup` / `@teardown` decorators.
   - `write_python_script`: verifies Jinja rendering under standard template environment, `NativeEnvironment`, and `StrictUndefined` missing variable error handling.
2. `airflow.providers.cncf.kubernetes.utils.delete_from`:
   - `FailToDeleteError`: verifies aggregation and formatted server error string generation.
   - `_delete_from_yaml_single_item`: verifies resource deletion on namespaced and non-namespaced Kubernetes resources.
   - `delete_from_yaml`: verifies parsing and deletion across multi-document YAML manifests and API class name derivation.
   - `delete_from_dict`: verifies recursive handling of `List` kinds and collection of multiple `ApiException` failures.
3. Updated `airflow-core/tests/unit/always/test_project_structure.py`:

### Description

Part of meta issue #35442 / systematic overlooked test resolution (#72265).

Adds dedicated unit tests for:
1. `providers/amazon/src/airflow/providers/amazon/aws/executors/batch/batch_executor_config.py`
   - Covers `_fetch_templated_kwargs` (valid JSON vs default fallback).
   - Covers `_fetch_config_values` (pruning None values).
   - Covers `build_submit_kwargs` (default container overrides, merging templated kwargs, rejecting unsupported nodeOverrides and eksPropertiesOverride, and JSON serialization validation).
2. `providers/amazon/src/airflow/providers/amazon/aws/executors/ecs/ecs_executor_config.py`
   - Covers `_fetch_templated_kwargs` and `_fetch_config_values` with fallback defaults.
   - Covers `build_task_kwargs`:
     - Mutual exclusivity check between `capacity_provider_strategy` and `launch_type`.
     - Cluster lookup fallback to Fargate when no default capacity provider strategy is configured.
     - EC2 launch type dropping `platform_version`.
     - Container overrides configuration and command initialization.
     - Networking configuration parsing (subnets, security groups, assign public IP) and validation error when subnets are missing.
     - JSON serialization error handling.

Retires both entries from `OVERLOOKED_TESTS` in `airflow-core/tests/unit/always/test_project_structure.py`.

- `providers/amazon/tests/unit/amazon/aws/executors/ecs/test_ecs_executor_config.py`
